gen-dafont-disorder-gf-chocolate-classic: Raw and scattered, Disorder sprawls with loose, unswelling strokes and widely spaced glyphs. Chocolate Classical Sans writes with a broad-nibbed pen stroke and a generous lowercase, so paragraphs of it would run smoothly.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-cossette-texte: Cossette Texte gives each lowercase e a wide-eyed look, with a prominent x-height, plus n arches matching the stems beside them. Disorder shouts above while the text below simply keeps its footing.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-gafata: Chaotic Disorder throws its glyphs far apart, while Gafata keeps a high band of lowercase with short stalks and wide-eyed e shapes. Longer paragraphs would feel contemporary and steady, never tiring.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-georama: Disorder has no calligraphic modulation at all, just flat raw lines with glyphs set well apart. Georama bends a wide c like a bracelet pulled apart, so long paragraphs would feel approachable.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-golos-text: Golos Text reads contemporary and approachable, its x-height filling the line. Disorder is best at raw, scattered attention-grabbing, while Golos Text is best at steady, one-width strokes and a widely parted s.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-hedvig-letters-sa: Hedvig Letters Sans reads approachable, with a clear gap where the c ends. Disorder draws a flat, unmodulated line while the body's small letters nearly reach capital height, and that gap is what stands out.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-heebo: One constant stroke width, with no swelling at the curves, gives Disorder its raw, chaotic look. Heebo ends its curves before they close, so long paragraphs would read cleanly.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-hind-guntur: Hind Guntur is stamped-metal sturdy, with wide gaps where curves meet stems. Beside raw, scattered Disorder, that cable-like outline gives the layout one steady anchor under all the noise.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-hind-madurai: Hind Madurai lets lowercase fill the line almost like capitals. Beside Disorder, its s curves open wide at both ends and strokes look cut from one ribbon, so long paragraphs would stay approachable.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-hind-vadodara: Disorder scatters its raw, unswelling glyphs with plenty of space between them. And Hind Vadodara settles in with rounded forms and spacious terminal gaps, clean beside all that mess.
